statements.statement: For application review, a review notice (RN) means a written request for missing application records.
In the context of application review, applicants must return the review notice (RN) within ten days unless a reviewer extends the deadline.
In the context of application review, reviewers may extend the deadline to return the review notice (RN) by five days only with a supervisor's approval.
Within equipment inspections, a review notice (RN) means a record that an inspection was completed; it is not a request for records.
Within equipment inspections, inspectors must issue a review notice (RN) after completing an inspection.
Within equipment inspections, operators may archive that review notice (RN) only after a manager's approval.
Within equipment inspections, where an RN is archived with manager approval, you must retain a copy of the approval email.
Under general record handling, records must be retained for two years.
ZX is an external reference code whose meaning is not supplied here.
